meta.title: SPVX-Lite
meta.tagline: SPVX-Lite measures daily uncertainty in maritime oil flows.
meta.description: Sources: AIS/port data plus weather adjustments; fixed at 12:00 UTC (T+1).
meta.ruleOfThumbText: Rule of thumb: 80–120 normal, 120–150 tense, >150 stress. Moves ≥ +10 pts are material.

methodology.summary: SPVX-Lite scales three components (CQ_SG, CQ_TR, PORT_EU) via seasonal z-scores, winsorises outliers, and combines them into a logistics stress level. Weights favour stability and low revisions over price fit.
methodology.interpretation: +10 points ≈ significant logistics stress increase. CQ_TR spikes highlight Bosphorus bottlenecks; CQ_SG signals Asia flow disruption; PORT_EU weakness points to reduced EU outflows.

PORT_EU.note: Tanker departures as EU outflow proxy

methodology.quality: Stale detection per component; stale contributions are down-weighted automatically (0–100%).
